app.title: Jeff – Jev-compatible 0.8B decision models, trained at home, ~30 ms
app.author: firelex
app.description: A lightweight library providing Jev-compatible 0.8B decision models that can be trained locally and executed with sub-30 ms latency.
proposed_tests: Run a forward pass with sample input and measure execution time
Validate output shape and type against expected schema
Compare inference latency to baseline Jev implementation
